hypothesis: A zero-initialized source-relative coordinate projection (dx,dz,r) can extend the exact r20 Helmholtz mapper without changing update-0 predictions, while receiving nonzero gradients on the same source-support panels within the existing memory budget.
expected_mechanism: The current mapper sees a source map and global source embedding but lacks an explicit per-pixel coordinate relative to the source. Adding normalized displacement and radius makes spatial Green-field dependence legible to the convolutional record mapper while preserving the parent exactly at initialization.
nature_evidence_role: This is only the static and smoke tier of the repository's Nature-level evidence gate. It makes no broad method or venue claim and cannot advance without independent source confirmation.

single_conceptual_variable.name: source_relative_spatial_features
single_conceptual_variable.candidate: zero-init 1x1 projection of dx, dz and radius added before the Helmholtz U-Net
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: r20 update-2600 checkpoint, onset-phase off, panels, 96 bins, frequency gate, coefficient loss, optimizer, learning rates, seed and metric

primary_metric: exact update-0 parent identity plus two finite updates with nonzero new-branch gradients and bound terminal/checkpoint artifacts
failure_signal: Any nonzero new parameter at load, update-0 prediction drift, missing gradient, state mismatch, non-finite value, OOM, missing binding, or peak CUDA above 4 GiB blocks a formal source-relative pilot.
rollback: Preserve r20-r26 artifacts. On smoke failure disable the optional feature and do not launch formal training.
